body.title: Cross-file pass: modes, Pass 0 and a class for every row
body.summary: In src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts: an explicit mode ('full' | 'settle' | 'repository', default 'repository') and committedFiles; Pass 0 promotes code-symbol rows whose awaited target is stored (settle: rows awaiting the committed files' entities; full: rows awaiting any entity of the repository, from any repository; repository: its own); rows awaiting a never-stored FILE id are classed by the t7 predicate ('not-code' -> 'no-candidate' reason 'target-not-code'; 'excluded-by-ignore' and a selected file not stored stay awaiting with reasons 'target-excluded-by-ignore' / 'target-not-committed'); Pass 2 writes 'ambiguous' or 'no-candidate' (reason 'no-match') in every mode; full mode classes leftover unattempted code-symbol rows 'no-candidate'; the result gains completedById and pendingByClass. runSettlePass (src/indexer/index.ts:856) passes mode 'settle' with the settled files; resolveAfterReconcile (src/indexer/index.ts:568) passes 'repository'. Anchors: runCrossFileResolver is at src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:107 (result type CrossFileResolveResult at :99; Pass 1 :159-256, Pass 2 :269-351); runSettlePass is the private method at src/indexer/index.ts:856 (it calls the pass per file with scopeFile at :864-866) and resolveAfterReconcile the protected method at src/indexer/index.ts:568 (:570). Depends on t4 (by-target read, meta merge), t5 (missing-file class, meta on writes), t6 (EXPORTS rows exist to be left for t9) and t7 (the selection predicate it classes file targets by). runCrossFileResolver has three indexer callers: fullIndex (src/indexer/index.ts:707, given mode 'full' by t11), runSettlePass (:864-866, mode 'settle' with committedFiles, this task) and resolveAfterReconcile (:570, mode 'repository', this task).
acceptanceChecks: ac1 fixture: a file sorting earlier imports and calls into a later one; after a first full index both edges are stored and findCallers returns the call site
After a settle that adds a call to JSON.parse, the row is 'no-candidate' and a complete repository stays complete; a settle that creates an awaited target promotes the rows awaiting it
An import of './logo.png' is 'no-candidate' (target-not-code); one of a .ts in an ignored directory stays awaiting (target-excluded-by-ignore)
resolveAfterReconcile changes neither fullIndexFinished nor the classes only a full index sets
